description: This file is a Perl script that generates configuration and profile metadata for target systems, including functions for processing target features, names, versions, and generating configuration structures based on parsed target metadata.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates feature configuration strings based on input feature list.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Constructs a target name, including parent if available.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version strings to a standardized format with underscores.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Prints configuration entries for a target, including features, dependencies, and help text.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two package lists, removing duplicates and handling negations.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Generates a full target configuration based on parsed target metadata.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile metadata in makefile format for a specific target.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and invokes appropriate functions.
